activation.note: Activation retains the at-least-one wagon, feature or WMBT precondition, all source files beneath the configured source_root, and the original excluded trees. Fires cover both placement and URN failures; unchanged files and WMBT-only plans correctly remain in scope. Paths and file kinds are observable, while plan-model inspection is explicitly identified as requiring an observer.

audit.summary: All segments survive at claimed destinations. The single placement obligation in then does not erase the URN requirement: avoid[2] explicitly retains it as required alongside placement, and the proposed split is declared. The shared strict-disposition node is generic and contains the claimed policy; no new waiver or undeclared coder-facing requirement appears.

segmentChecks.note: The placement and URN grammar survive, but the source's repeated wagon/feature variables require the URN and directory to identify the same feature. The rewrite demotes that correspondence to prefer[1]; then, avoid, fires, and evidence would accept a well-formed URN naming a different plan-declared feature.
The package-rule nature and original strict statement remain in audit, while shared:policy.strict-disposition preserves the operational meaning of strict.
All four topology keys and defaults remain in verifier_detail[2], and source_root's key and default are also available in activation and given.
why retains tracing by URN and discovery by path.
why preserves the consequence that missing either trace prevents demonstrating an implementation.
prefer[0] retains both parts of the fix: move the file and add the component URN header.
All four excluded trees are retained in unless, activation, and verifier_detail.
shared:policy.strict-disposition explicitly says every finding fails and there is no advisory mode.
audit preserves the validator type and atdd_topology reference, and evidence identifies the same validator's clean result.

risks: A weak coder can treat URN/directory agreement as optional because it appears only under prefer. Following then and avoid literally, it could place a file under one declared feature while its well-formed URN names another, and the stated evidence would still pass.

unobservable: Whether the plan under plan_root declares at least one wagon, feature, or WMBT is not currently observable; the author correctly marks it needs_new_observer and says a plan reader is required.

review.summary: Most content is retained, including strictness, exclusions, defaults, and the split URN grammar. However, S006's URN/path feature correspondence is weakened from a requirement to a preference, allowing a mismatched URN and directory to pass the rewritten checks. I therefore disagree with the auditor's PASS; applicability also depends on the explicitly declared new plan observer.
